title: Arista Networks security advisory (AV26-751)
description: As of July 27, 2026, Arista Networks is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product:
products:
VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem
	from 5.2.0 to versions prior to 5.2.3.14
from 6.1.0 to versions prior to 6.1.3.4
from 6.4.0 to versions prior to 6.4.2.4
from 7.0.0 to versions prior to 7.0.0.1
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
